usedFor: Zoho Contracts organizes contracts, and “Create Department” and “Create Obligation Category” set up how they are grouped.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Obligation Category” in Zoho Contracts
bestTemplate.why: It creates a category to organize contract obligations, so new work has a place.

watchOut: Each run of “Create Department” in Zoho Contracts adds a department, so check the trigger to avoid repeats.
